name: Lord of Death raises Ghostly Weapon's damage multiplier to 25% (#3490)
contract: Lord of Death 805194 is obtainable (CharacterAdvancement level 0, live capture and calculator agree) and reads 'Abilities affected by Ghostly Weapon now deal 25% more damage per additional target'. Its effect 0 is aura 107 (ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER) MiscValue 12 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT2, effect index 1 of the matched spell), BasePoints 24 / DieSides 1 = +25, over classmask (0, 0, 1073741824) which matches Ghostly Weapon 803997's own SpellFamilyFlags (family 36, word 2 bit 30). Ghostly Weapon's effect index 1 is itself an ADD_PCT_MODIFIER on SPELLMOD_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER with a baseline value of 0, so the native spellmod chain lands exactly the tooltip's flat 25% on the Ghostly Weapon-affected abilities; no handler is required for this half and this scenario guards it. The tooltip's 'per additional target' clause has no representation in the shipped data (PR #5416 recorded this), and effect 2 (aura 42 on the 20% Lord of Death buff 807168) has ProcFlags 0, no spell_proc row and no derivable condition, so that half stays an unresolved expectation rather than invented behavior.

steps.label: SETUP: Ghostly Weapon's damage-multiplier modifier is at its 0 baseline
DISCRIMINATING: Lord of Death raises it to 25
